description: S59 T7 (EV16, EV17) at the DOOR, before the records plane is consulted: the agent's one ask carries no identity. `actor` in environment.proposeRestrict's params is refused with the transport's bad-params code and the refusal NAMES the key — the author of an environment proposal is the STEP the connection belongs to, stamped from the step context (OL3), and a caller that could name an author could file a tightening as an agent that was never there. `backend` and `revision` are refused by the same door for the same reason: the backend an environment runs on moves only through environment.update, by a person, and the baseline an ask is written against is the one the service READS, not one a model can type. fromDoor is why the walker dispatches this against a HEALTHY records seam — the claim of a door refusal is that it happened before the plane was consulted, and the walker asserts the seam was never called. The refusal is a transport-level condition, so it keeps JSON-RPC's own code and carries no `data` (conformance/README).

params.reason: HOME is not read by the build and every name passed is a name exposed

error.message: invalid params: environment.proposeRestrict params carry "actor" — the caller names what to act on, never who acted, when it happened, which origin it carries, or where a value lives (S59 EV7, EV17)
